correctness.rationale: The open-neighborhood blade equation, hub inequality, Roman-neighbor requirement, and all three hub cases have been proved with quantified m>=2,t>=3. Parity lower bounds are attained. The optimal-function census follows from nonnegative integer solutions for blade labels. Independent exact exhaustive and dynamic computations agree; only the proof establishes the infinite cases.
